title: matter: Display some dissected data in COL_INFO column
description:
The info column is helpful for fast inspection what given packet contains. Current matter dissector does not update the INFO column, so it contains UDP-related information only which is not helpful for inspecting Matter protocol.

This merge request adds session type, source and destination ID and counters (source and ACK) to the INFO column.
Also, it updates the display format for counter fields. The massage counter and the acknowledgment counter are monotonically increasing counters, so they should be displayed as decimal values.
The last change is MAC (Message Integrity Check (MIC) in Matter nomenclature) separation from the encrypted payload (Matter uses Authenticated-Encryption with Associated-Data).
